svg.title: Two cards: placement and failover
svg.desc: Two panels of the two cards' slots as the gateway bounds them, a tray a card, two call slots each and up to 4 agents' sessions on Phastform and 12 on Gray: in panel a, in service, both calls fill Phastform, the first card in the file's order, and Gray, the warm spare, runs agents only; in panel b, Phastform's engine failed, both calls take Gray's call slots at their next turn, 0.7 s after a kill and 1.9 s after a stop in the drills, and Gray holds its agents' requests until the moved calls end.
svg.text: next turn: 0.7 s after a kill,
